contexts.text: The dispersion of falsity. Signified.
By them the whole earth was scattered over () = that hence were derived all doctrines, both true and false.
From these were scattered over the islands of the nations in their lands () = that the worships of a number of nations came forth from these.
Afterwards, were scattered about the families of the Canaanites () = that all the other idolatrous worships are thence.
From these were scattered abroad the nations in the earth () = that thence came all the worships of the Church as to goods or evils.
Lest we be scattered abroad upon the faces of the whole earth () = that otherwise they would not be acknowledged. Explained.
Jehovah scattered them abroad upon the faces of the whole earth () = that they were not acknowledged.
Thence did Jehovah scatter them abroad upon the faces of the whole earth () = that internal worship was annihilated; (for) to be scattered abroad = to be dissipated.
This Infirm... from the mother... is dispersed during regeneration.
The dispersed of Judah () = their goods.
When the Jews were dispersed.

I will divide them in Jacob and scatter them in Israel () = that goods and truths shall no longer be in their external and internal Church; to divide and to scatter = to separate and extirpate from them.

I will scatter them in Israel = that they are to be exterminated from the spiritual man. To scatter = extermination. But to scatter is thus distinguished from to divide; that the latter is predicated of the external man and of truth, and the former of the internal man and of good.
To scatter into every wind () = to dissipate truths.
The people scattered itself abroad in all the land of Egypt () = that they diffused the natural mind in every direction. To scatter itself abroad = to diffuse.
Vastation is signified by their dispersion.
The aspect of the damned dispersed here and there. Signified.
Under Divide, see this reference.
To scatter () = to dissipate. AE 627:13.
The truths... by which evils and falsities are dispersed. Signified.
That now the Roman Catholic religiosity as to its dogmas and doctrinals is dispersed. Signified.
The dispersion of falsities by doctrine thence. Signified.
The horns which have scattered them () = the falsities of evil which have vastated the Church.
Until ye have scattered them abroad ().
With thee will I scatter the nations... and by thee will I scatter the horse and his rider, and by thee will I scatter the chariot and its rider ().
He scattereth the cummin ().
Cast forth a thunderbolt and scatter them () = the Divine truth through which they are dissipated.

The destruction of the falsities of evil is signified by to scatter them to the rock (). To scatter = to destroy... He is said to be blessed who scatters the falsities of evil which are nascent in the Church.
Vastation as to all things of good and truth, until there is not anything left, is signified by, I will scatter them into every wind, into the cuttings off of the corner (). AE 418:7.
Under Wind, see this reference.
The dispersed of Judah = those who are in the good of life, and thereby in love to the Lord.
To scatter among the nations = to destroy through the falsities of evil.
As they disperse the truths of the Church, it is said he scattereth the peoples.
Arise O Jehovah that thine enemies may be scattered.
